title: Synthesis, structure elucidation, SC-XRD/DFT, molecular modelling simulations and DNA binding studies of 3,5-diphenyl-4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazole chalcones.
authors: Mustafa, Ghulam; Sabir, Sabreena; Sumrra, Sajjad Hussain; Zafar, Wardha; Arshad, Muhammad Nadeem; Hassan, Abrar Ul; Akhtar, Arusa; Ashfaq, Muhammad; Ashfaq, Maryam; Mohamed Asiri, Abdullah
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成吡唑啉查尔酮衍生物，通过光谱实验和分子对接研究其与DNA的非共价结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（实为小分子-DNA）且含对接方法，但非TF-DNA体系，方法深度有限。
abstract: Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) acts as the most important intracellular target for various drugs. Exploring the DNA binding interactions of small bioactive molecules offers a structural guideline for designing new drugs with higher clinical efficacy and enhanced selectivity. This study presents the facile synthesis of pyrazoline-derived compounds (4a)-(4f) by reacting substituted chalcones with hydrazine hydrate using formic acid. The structure elucidation of substituted pyrazoline compounds was carried out using (1)H-NMR, FT-IR and elemental analyses. While the crystal structures of two compounds (4a) and (4b) have been resolved by single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SC-XRD) analysis. Hirshfeld surface analysis also endorsed their greater molecular stability. Computational calculations at DFT/B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) were executed to compare the structural properties (bond angle and bond length) and explore reactivity descriptors, frontier molecular orbitals (FMO), Mulliken atomic charges (MAC), molecular electrostatic potential (MEP) and electronic properties. All the compounds were evaluated for DNA binding interactions by UV-Vis spectrophotometric analysis. The results revealed that compounds (4a)-(4f) bind to DNA via non-covalent binding mode having binding constant values ranging from 1.22 x 10(3) to 6.81 x 10(4) M(-1). The negative values of Gibbs free energy also proved the interaction of studied compounds with DNA as a spontaneous process. The findings of molecular docking simulations depicted that these studied compounds showed significant binding interactions with DNA and these results were consistent with experimental findings. Compound (4b) was concluded as the most potent compound of the series with the highest binding constant (4.95 x 10(4)) and strongest binding affinity (-8.48 kcal/mol).Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）作为多种药物最重要的细胞内靶点。探索小生物活性分子与DNA的结合相互作用，为设计具有更高临床疗效和增强选择性的新药提供了结构指导。本研究通过取代查尔酮与水合肼在甲酸存在下反应，简便合成了吡唑啉衍生物（4a）-（4f）。利用（1）H-NMR、FT-IR和元素分析对取代吡唑啉化合物进行了结构鉴定。同时，通过单晶X射线衍射（SC-XRD）分析解析了两种化合物（4a）和（4b）的晶体结构。Hirshfeld表面分析也证实了它们更高的分子稳定性。在DFT/B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p)水平上进行了计算，以比较结构性质（键角和键长），并探索反应性描述符、前沿分子轨道（FMO）、Mulliken原子电荷（MAC）、分子静电势（MEP）和电子性质。所有化合物均通过紫外-可见分光光度分析评估了其DNA结合相互作用。结果表明，化合物（4a）-（4f）以非共价结合模式与DNA结合，结合常数范围在1.22 x 10(3)至6.81 x 10(4) M(-1)之间。吉布斯自由能的负值也证明了所研究化合物与DNA的相互作用是一个自发过程。分子对接模拟的结果表明，这些所研究的化合物与DNA表现出显著的结合相互作用，这些结果与实验发现一致。化合物（4b）被认定为该系列中最有效的化合物，具有最高的结合常数（4.95 x 10(4)）和最强的结合亲和力（-8.48 kcal/mol）。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
